evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen was 3.3 ppm after remaining approximately 3–6 ppm through the ramp.
Oxygen increased to 11.6 ppm during growth.
Oxygen reached 32.4 ppm despite temperature near setpoint (750.1 °C), argon near setpoint (99.6 sccm), stable pressure (759.9 Torr), and running status.
